gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-pontano-sans: Expressive from the first word, Shantell Sans draws every stroke with one fixed nib, like twine pressed flat. Pontano Sans takes over for reading, its wide c terminals keeping the text open and quietly modern.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-red-hat-text: Red Hat Text sets down curvy, unclamped letters in a line as fine as a technical drawing pen. And Shantell Sans, with its wide, can-lid mouths up top, gives a long read a playful nudge.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans reads level-headed, with an e that leaves a wide gap at its terminal and strokes that hold steady in every direction. Shantell Sans loosens things up above it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-roboto-flex: Shantell Sans looks bent from a single length of wire, wide-mouthed and full of personality, and that is where it does its best work. Roboto Flex stays modern and easygoing, with a generous slot between the ends of its c, built to carry the actual reading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ruluko: Shantell Sans lets full-width strokes take over where thin hairline joins would go. Ruluko answers with broad, open counters on c and s, so you can size it for comfortable reading without touching the heading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sarabun: Chunky, hand-drawn and a bit cheeky: Shantell Sans keeps one line width that never swells or tapers. Sarabun then steps in with a wide channel into every bowl, giving the heading a clear, approachable partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sarala: Marker-bold and playful, Shantell Sans leads the way. Sarala follows with distinct gaps in its c, e and s and a stroke like neon glass tubing, which makes extended reading feel contemporary and easygoing.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro brings open aperture curves through the whole alphabet, a body font that feels modern and unfussy under Shantell Sans, whose letters look drawn with a round-tipped pen. Their strongest quality is that friendly looseness.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-suse-mono: Shantell Sans keeps the same line width in its curves and straights. SUSE Mono then spreads out beneath it, with open curves, clear gaps and extra room around every letter, making long reading feel unhurried and approachable.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter keeps every small counter unclogged, so the body text feels clean and professional beneath a heading with signage-like plainness. Shantell Sans supplies the personality; the strength here is that clear division of roles.
